quotes.author: cipugh27
quotes.text: The people who drove the Brewboat were so much fun! We were there celebrating my bachelorette party and we had such a fun time. They volunteered to take pictures of us with the amazing view, they suggested games we could play, and had the best customer service I’ve had in a long time! We’re planning on doing it again soon!

quotes.author: Amy S
quotes.text: Celebrated my 24th birthday on the BrewBoat CLE! My friends and I had the best time and I would highly recommend this for anyone interested. We had the best crew who made our trip extremely enjoyable and fun (s/o Mike) and we will all look forward to doing the BrewBoat again. Excellent experience!

quotes.author: FarAway139129
quotes.text: We had a great time on the BrewBoat celebrating my sister-in-laws birthday. It was a first time on the boat for everyone. You can rent the entire boat which we did since it was a family affair. The captain and mate were very friendly and accommodating. I highly recommend taking the cruise.

quotes.author: jennabeyer2
quotes.text: We had a blast on the Brew Boat. Our tour guide was so cute, fun, spunky and energetic. We wanted to go a second time around!!! We will definitely do it again!

quotes.author: ashleeyy4
quotes.text: My friends & I rented a brewboat for my birthday & had the absolute best time! The crew was great & very friendly. We will definitely be back!

quotes.author: haileywallace05
quotes.text: This was so much fun! Freddie and the other captain were AMAZING! They were fun and energetic! We would definitely do this again!!!
